# Novumism

> A comprehensive religion, philosophy, and metaphysics by Ryan Miller.
> Series site: https://novumism.com/

The Novumism series has three books. Full chapter markdown is published for LLM and scraper access.

## Books

- [Novum Carta (Book I)](https://novumism.com/novum-carta/): The New Charter — religion, philosophy, and metaphysics. Complete markdown.
- [The Civilizational Man (Book II)](https://novumism.com/the-civilizational-man/): Ethics, morality, and duty to civilization. Draft markdown (Available 2026).
- [The Great Orchestration (Book III)](https://novumism.com/the-great-orchestration/): The architecture of our reality. Forthcoming (Available 2028).

## Notes for scrapers

- Prefer the raw `.md` chapter files linked from each book directory TOC.
- Novum Carta chapters are flat under `/novum-carta/`; images under `/novum-carta/images/`.
- The Civilizational Man keeps section folders; images under `/the-civilizational-man/images/` with `../images/` links from chapters.
- This site uses GitHub Pages with `.nojekyll` (static files served as-is).
